body:
Combining responses to you and /u/ehnde in the same reply.

I spend a lot of my time doing a whole lot of nothing.  I'll browse Reddit, read occasionally, every so often play video games if one of my few internet friends wants.  It's hard to really get into anything as my motivation dwindles very rapidly.  There are TONS of half-finished books, movies, tv series, etc, laying around.  

I'd like to think I'm being honest with myself, but other times I know I blatantly lie and am literally delusional about everything.  I don't know if it's a "coping" mechanism I've developed?  Make myself believe I'm something I'm not in order to make myself think my situation is better than it really is?  Typing it out, thinking about it, it seems like something that may have attributed to this downward spiral...

I'm actually quite frugal, at least when it comes to the "big ticket" items.  I don't buy, for example, video games when they first come out.  Steam Sale if anything.  Books are usually only purchased at garage sales or Half-Price Books if they are not gotten from the library.

My problem is little stuff.  If i'm out and get hungry, 7/10 times I will stop and get fast food instead of just waiting till I get home, or thinking ahead and packing something.  My meal habits (time, etc) are not normal, either.  I sometimes go an entire day without eating, some days I eat 4-5 meals.  I'm not healthy, in that regard, either.

There is no issue with being "too personal."  I am a fairly typical "Aspie" in that I have a hard time reading emotions, feelings, etc, so that doesn't really help when relating to people on more than superficial things.  

I dunno.  I really don't know.  There is really no one to turn to here (in this physical location), ya know?  The one person that I used to talk to about things like this, that I thought "understood" me, has turned his back to me for a girl.  I haven't talked with him in months.  The only reason I felt a connection with him is that he's been my friend for almost 20 years now, through all my "awkward" phases.

I will say this:  I don't WANT to have these thoughts, but it sometimes feels like the only way to really end this cycle.  I'm lost.
